review_scope: Primary read the full first-pass report and independently read the complete generator and browser JavaScript. The first-pass reviewer read all other required files completely.
decision: Keep all baseline labels and no supported configuration exception. Rigid piece orientation, three-dimensional occupancy and remaining cavities determine valid exact coverage. Camera inspection exposes spatial relationships not available from one overlapped view. Dragging, axis rotations and placement are untimed spatial operations, with no continuing world effect while an input is merely held.

rationale_clarifications.exploration_interface: The evidence is active inspection of rear/interior volume and overlapping pieces. The grader's camera-event quota is transcript wiring, not by itself evidence of an exploration capability.
rationale_clarifications.reasoning_planning: The full interface snaps a drop to the nearest valid projected candidate, which assists placement but does not supply a global exact-cover plan. The agent must still choose orientations and a compatible sequence of piece placements.

uncertainties: Source-based capability judgments; no screenshot-only gameplay or empirical validation of profile boundaries.
